services.title: What I do for small businesses in Vienna

items.title: Get found
items.text: Google profile, website copy, and social set up so people find you when they look.

items.title: Build a community
items.text: Instagram and a newsletter with a plan, so first-time visitors become regulars. I set up the newsletter, write it, and show you the numbers.

items.title: Fill events and offers
items.text: Campaigns for events, courses, and launches, from the announcement to a full booking sheet.

packages.title: Packages and prices
packages.intro: You can start small. A lot of people begin with the check, then decide how much to hand over.

items.title: Communication check
items.text: I look at where you stand and tell you what matters first.
points: Analysis of Instagram, Google profile, website, and newsletter

items.title: Strategy package
items.text: You get a plan for the next three months, which you carry out yourself or with me.

items.title: Ongoing support
items.text: I take over social media and the newsletter, and you get the numbers every month.

cases.title: Selected work
cases.intro: A lot of my work comes from sport and events. The same idea works anywhere people are meant to come back.

items.name: Rock a Rail
items.caption: ticket purchases with about €830 in ads
items.text: For the Hungarian Snowboard Association (2026), as communications lead, I was responsible for social media, the newsletter, and ads for the event: 535 RSVPs, about 690,000 views, over 70% of them from non-followers.

items.name: Red Bull X-Alps 2023
items.caption: video views on Instagram in 3 weeks
items.text: With Zoom Productions I was part of the two-person social media team. I looked after the race from preparation through the follow-up and produced content throughout.

items.name: BODYART ZEN
items.caption: tickets, sold out (ZEN 2025)
items.text: Since 2023 I have been planning communications for BODYART’s biggest event. ZEN 2026 was over 70% sold two months beforehand.

items.name: Go Primal
items.caption: new retailers in 3 months
items.text: From 2023 to 2025 I built the brand, content, and sales for the DACH region, especially at CrossFit boxes, and organised events such as “Women Gone Strong” (sold out).

cases.also: Also: newsletter launch BODYART × BrainGood (68 webinar sign-ups) · Hungarian Post (silver, Content Marketing Award 2021, via Dot Creative) · Double Shot (social media via Dot Creative)
